item.title: Single intent instruments
item.description: I’ve written before on single purpose tools, and this year I’ve been thinking more about it and somehow it didn’t feel right. The purpose of a device or tool should not be single minded. For example, the intent of a typewriter is to write, but you can write whatever you want, whether it’s poetry or propaganda. The purpose of the single action does differ from action to action. So I have to rephrase the idea a bit.
